solution: Residents assumed the library would reopen within a few months.
The engineers' report found long-ignored cracks in the foundation, a serious problem.
The mayor refuses to give a reopening date and puts safety before convenience, which implies a long repair.
So the repairs will likely take longer than residents expected.
questions.explanation: B is supported: residents expected a reopening within a few months, but serious foundation damage and the mayor's refusal to name a date imply a longer wait. A is wrong: the cracks were 'ignored for years', but the passage never says the council hid them on purpose. C is wrong: nothing shows the engineers and the mayor disagree about the cause; the mayor only declines to give a date. D is wrong: the passage speaks of repairs and says nothing about permanent closure or a new building.

uncertainty.reason: B is the only option the passage supports by inference; the others go beyond the text.
